scenes.headline: How an LLM's cache and speed get priced
scenes.sub: Modular's inference handbook, checked one formula at a time.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Freesia! Modular's inference handbook prices memory and speed with simple formulas. Here's how they work.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Every formula here is right. What matters is the input: a KV cache counts the heads it caches, not the attention heads.
scenes.say: Every formula here is right. What matters is the input: a KV cache counts cached heads, not attention heads.

scenes.title: What one token costs in cache
scenes.text: 2 x layers x KV heads x head dim x bytes
scenes.say: Here's one token's cache, for Llama 3 8B.

parts.note: 32 in Llama 3 8B, each with its own cache
parts.say: Thirty-two layers, each with its own cache.

parts.note: 8 cached heads, not the 32 attention heads
parts.say: Eight KV heads, not thirty-two attention heads: four query heads share each cached head.

parts.note: 128 per head, 2 bytes each: 131,072 bytes a token
parts.say: Head dimension one twenty-eight, two bytes each: about a hundred and thirty-one thousand bytes a token.

scenes.title: A hybrid model caches even less

steps.say: Qwen3-Next has forty-eight layers; only every fourth keeps a KV cache. The rest hold a fixed state.

steps.note: 16 query heads share 2 cached KV heads
steps.say: In those twelve, sixteen query heads share two cached heads: eight times smaller, then four times again.

steps.note: 192 GiB from attention heads; 6 GiB cached
steps.say: With attention heads, the handbook's calculator says a hundred and ninety-two gigabytes. The real cache is six.
A draft model reads the context and guesses three tokens ahead: nice, today, outside.
The target model checks all three in one pass, and keeps the longest prefix it agrees with.
It keeps nice and today, rejects outside, and adds its own word, for. Three tokens for one pass.

steps.note: servers log accepted over proposed: 2 of 3
steps.say: Servers log accepted over proposed: two thirds. Leviathan's formula wants something else: the chance each reached position is accepted.

scenes.label: the handbook's formula, fed the logged acceptance rate, at seven drafted tokens
scenes.note: Qwen3-8B with EAGLE-3 on MI300X; the measured length keeps rising
scenes.say: Fed that logged rate, the formula runs fifty-five percent low at seven drafted tokens.

scenes.text: A formula is only as right as its input. Price the KV cache from KV heads, cached layers and dtype.
scenes.mark: only as right as its input
scenes.say: A formula is only as right as its input. Price the cache from KV heads, cached layers and cache type.

recap: The KV cache counts KV heads, not attention heads
A hybrid caches only one layer in four
Logged acceptance is not Leviathan's alpha
scenes.say: To recap: count KV heads and cached layers, and know which acceptance rate you have.
